> Ten minutes of your time makes the next workshop better.

## Post-workshop survey

Please complete the survey before you leave. It is short, anonymous, and it is
the main thing that shapes future workshops.

::: {.callout-note}
## Survey link
The survey link will be shared during the closing session.

<!-- Replace with your live form URL:
### [Complete the post-workshop survey](https://forms.gle/YOUR-FORM-HERE){target="_blank"}
-->
:::

## What we would like to know

- Which section was most useful? Which was hardest to follow?
- Was the pace right?
- Did the hands-on case study change how you think about your own data?
- What would you remove to make room for more of something else?

::: {.callout-tip}
## Be blunt
"Module 4 lost me in the first ten minutes" is far more useful than "it was
good". Negative, specific feedback is the most valuable thing you can leave us.
:::

## Keeping your work

Your files and rendered notebooks are yours. Before you leave:

1. Download your working directory.
2. Note the dataset locations under [Datasets](../../datasets.qmd).
3. Install R, RStudio, and Quarto locally — see
   [Installation](../../installation-instructions.qmd).

## Staying in touch

Bring your own data to the clinic in [Hands-On](../4-hands-on/index.qmd), and
keep the contact details from the closing session. The analysis questions that
matter usually arrive weeks after the workshop ends.

## Thank you

You came to learn how to analyse data. We hope you leave with something more
useful: the judgement to know when the data cannot answer the question — and
the confidence to say so.
